title: lncRNA ENST000000454471 promotes lung adenocarcinoma progression and tumor immune escape: Protein structure and biological functions of histone deacetylase 8.
authors: Ye, Zaiting; Ye, Siyu; Yin, Zhangyong; Jiang, Yiwei; Wang, Xin; Cai, Xiaoping; Cao, Zhuo
one_liner_zh: 该文研究lncRNA与HDAC8在肺腺癌中的作用，虽涉及HDAC8蛋白结构模拟，但核心是肿瘤进展与免疫逃逸，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联弱。
abstract: The purpose of this study was to investigate the role of lncRNA ENST0000000454471 in lung adenocarcinoma progression and tumor immune escape, and to analyze the protein structure and biological function of HDAC8. Various experimental techniques were used in this study, including real-time quantitative PCR (qPCR) to detect the difference in lncRNA ENST0000000454471 expression between lung adenocarcinoma tissue and normal lung tissue. Cell experiments included cell proliferation, migration and invasion experiments to evaluate the effect of lncRNA ENST0000000454471 on the behavior of lung adenocarcinoma cells. Molecular biological techniques such as chromatin immunoprecipitation (ChIP) and co-immunoprecipitation (Co-IP) were used to investigate the interaction between lncRNA ENST0000000454471 and HDAC8. The protein structure was analyzed by X-ray crystallography and molecular dynamics simulation. Cell experiments showed that overexpression of lncRNA ENST0000000454471 promoted the proliferation, migration and invasion of lung adenocarcinoma cells, and inhibitors of HDAC8 could reverse these effects. Further molecular mechanism studies showed that lncRNA ENST0000000454471 regulates the expression of several genes related to tumor progression and immune escape through interaction with HDAC8. Protein structure analysis revealed the active sites and regulatory regions of HDAC8, providing a structural basis for understanding its biological function.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨lncRNA ENST0000000454471在肺腺癌进展及肿瘤免疫逃逸中的作用，并分析HDAC8的蛋白质结构及其生物学功能。本研究采用了多种实验技术，包括实时定量PCR（qPCR）检测肺腺癌组织与正常肺组织中lncRNA ENST0000000454471表达的差异。细胞实验包括细胞增殖、迁移和侵袭实验，以评估lncRNA ENST0000000454471对肺腺癌细胞行为的影响。采用染色质免疫沉淀（ChIP）和共免疫沉淀（Co-IP）等分子生物学技术，研究lncRNA ENST0000000454471与HDAC8之间的相互作用。通过X射线晶体学和分子动力学模拟分析蛋白质结构。细胞实验表明，lncRNA ENST0000000454471的过表达促进了肺腺癌细胞的增殖、迁移和侵袭，而HDAC8抑制剂可逆转这些效应。进一步的分子机制研究显示，lncRNA ENST0000000454471通过与HDAC8的相互作用，调控多个与肿瘤进展和免疫逃逸相关基因的表达。蛋白质结构分析揭示了HDAC8的活性位点和调控区域，为理解其生物学功能提供了结构基础。
